description: Suggest installing the Agent Toolkit for AWS when a supported AI coding agent is detected. An interactive prompt is shown after ``aws configure``, ``aws configure sso``, and a first-time ``aws login`` that creates a new profile; it appears only when no AWS skills are installed and can be permanently suppressed by answering ``never`` or by setting the ``AWS_CLI_AGENT_TOOLKIT_HINT_DISABLED`` environment variable to ``true``. A non-interactive tip is also printed by the install scripts and after ``aws update``.
